title: serv__ — FastAPI multi-provider LLM gateway
summary: Repository /home/user/serv__ (github.com/Adarshukumar/serv__) holds a FastAPI server that fronts 7 third-party LLM providers behind a unified /v1/chat interface, packaged for Hugging Face Spaces on port 7860. A second directory holds an in-flight v3 rewrite of the Upstage provider.

facts.claim: Repo root is /home/user/serv__; origin https://github.com/Adarshukumar/serv__.git; single commit e57f3a2 'init'; default branch main.
18 tracked files, 11,625 lines of Python, in two directories: 'My PREVIOUS ENTIRE SERVER/' and 'New Upstage Change Logs/'. No root-level README, CI config, .gitignore, .env, or tests.

Server.py (1314 lines) exposes GET /, /health, /v1/models, /internal/v1/models, /v1/sessions/{user_id}, /v1/users, /v1/status; DELETE /v1/sessions/{user_id}; POST /v1/session/reset, /v1/warmup, /v1/credentials/refresh, /v1/chat, /v1/chat/completions, /v1/chat/stream.

7 providers registered in API/Client.py _PROVIDER_SPECS: DeepInfra (sync), Dolphin (async), DevsDo (async), Mercury/Inception (async, heavy_connect), LLMChat (async), mCloudFlare (sync), Upstage (async, heavy_connect).
API/Models.py (1528 lines) is a cross-provider model registry; its header documents Upstage 4 models, Mercury 1, mCloudFlare 4, LLMChat 24, Dolphin 2, DevsDo 52.
evidence: My PREVIOUS ENTIRE SERVER/API/Models.py docstring lines 1-35

facts.claim: requirements.txt declares 10 deps: fastapi, uvicorn[standard], pydantic, aiohttp, aiofiles, requests, cloudscraper, curl-cffi, DrissionPage, python-multipart.

Dockerfile targets python:3.11-slim for HF Spaces: non-root appuser uid/gid 1000, EXPOSE 7860, HEALTHCHECK curl /health, installs chromium + chromium-driver + xvfb for DrissionPage, sets SERVER_SYSTEM_PROMPT and ~15 SERVER_* env defaults.

The Upstage provider authenticates by capturing browser-session credentials (CSRF token + cookies) rather than a static API key; both v2 and v3 implement _Creds with load/save/clear/verify/capture and a cache dir (UPSTAGE_CACHE_DIR).
Directory names contain spaces, so every shell path must be quoted.
